scope: Seven researched Brazil / South Africa starter identities with downloaded, visually inspected period references. This index contains no completed game-art claim.
approved_style: Use the existing user-approved compact cartoon country-selector avatar style; the references establish identities and period appearances.

references.name: Luiz Gushiken
references.date_basis: Foundation archive item LGS_F_0005_0002 explicitly dates the candidacy photo to 1990.
references.credit: Esdras Martins; Centro Sérgio Buarque de Holanda / Fundação Perseu Abramo
references.appearance: Dark medium-length center/side-part hair; moustache joining pointed goatee; smiling; no glasses; white open-collar shirt.
limitations: Small 480×316 group photograph.
Photo rights are reserved; use as likeness research for a new cartoon, not as a game photograph.

references.name: Hugo Napoleão
references.date_basis: The photographed printed caption says 1988 and the journalist's archive post repeats that date.
references.credit: Archive image published by journalist Magno Martins; original photographer unspecified.
references.subject_position: LEFT, smiling; José Aparecido de Oliveira is RIGHT.
references.appearance: Thick dark side-parted hair with volume, heavy eyebrows, clean-shaven, strong rounded/long nose, taupe suit, white shirt, striped tie.
limitations: A photograph of a printed photograph, not an original negative.
Exact capture day and original photographer are not supplied.
Hugo was born 1943-10-31: age46 at the January1990 campaign start.

references.name: Leonel Brizola
references.date_basis: Photographer Sandra de Souza's caption dates the Cinelândia rally to 20 October1989.
references.credit: Sandra de Souza, all rights reserved.
references.subject_position: LEFT / center, raising both arms; do not draw the man at RIGHT as Brizola.
references.appearance: Receding silver/white swept-back hair, long prominent nose, clean-shaven, white open-neck shirt.
limitations: Flickr's 2011 taken/upload metadata describes digitization; the caption supplies the1989 event date.
Side view and raised arms partially obscure the hairline.
Visual research for new artwork; do not reproduce photograph or border.

references.name: Oliver Tambo
references.date_basis: RNZ / BBC Witness homecoming reference labels the event December1990. Image search caption gives13December1990, but use the conservative month until the exact day is independently checked.
references.credit: RNZ / BBC Witness public program reference; original photograph credit not resolved.
references.appearance: High bald forehead, short gray hair at sides/back, very large dark square/aviator spectacles with lightly tinted lenses, close gray moustache and short jaw beard, lined cheeks, gray suit and patterned tie.
limitations: Reference is late1990, about eleven months after the January starter.
Exact day in filename is a lead, not a verified date claim.
Do not reproduce the BBC mark, crowd, or photograph.

references.name: F. W. de Klerk
references.date_basis: The Namibian's AFP caption explicitly identifies the21March1990 Namibian independence ceremony.
references.subject_position: RIGHT, seated and leaning toward Sam Nujoma at LEFT.
references.appearance: Bald top, short gray side/back hair, prominent nose, thin wire-rim glasses, clean-shaven, pale complexion, dark suit and burgundy patterned tie.
limitations: Profile view; hand partly hides the chin.
Nujoma at LEFT is a different person.
Visual research for new artwork, not photo reproduction.

references.name: Mangosuthu Buthelezi
references.date_basis: Public lead-photo caption identifies Durban rally on20November1989.
references.credit: Walter Dhladhla / AFP; public lead image and caption.
references.subject_position: CENTER at lectern, raising right arm.
references.appearance: Dark trimmed full jaw beard and moustache, large gold/clear square aviator glasses, short cylindrical Zulu cap with geometric black/yellow/green/red bands, tan high-collar jacket, neck medallion.
limitations: Only public lead content of the premium article was accessed; no restricted gallery was bypassed.
Cap covers much of the hairline.
Do not copy AFP mark or photograph.

references.name: Zephania Mothopeng
references.date_basis: Firsthand participant and academic Gavin Brown publishes an Andy Higginbottom archive photograph captioned London, April1989.
references.credit: Personal archive of Andy Higginbottom, published by Gavin Brown.
references.subject_position: Seated CENTER in gray zip jacket; Urbania in red headscarf is to his left in the image.
references.appearance: Short salt-and-pepper tightly curled hair, narrow gray moustache, broad nose, textured/marked cheeks, no glasses, gray jacket over light striped shirt.
limitations: 6928×4784 group photo; use the identified central subject.
The post's18April airport-arrival diary date is not the date of this separate group photograph.
Prefer this dated reference over the undated IOL photo.

Likeness is identified but capture date is not supplied; his1990 death is only an upper bound. Prefer the dated April1989 archive photograph.
